response.sql:
WITH type_counts AS (
  SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM orderexecutions AS e
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark
  GROUP BY o.ordertune
), shares AS (
  SELECT order_count,
         order_count::numeric / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM type_counts
), scored AS (
  SELECT order_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS overall_avg_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT SUM(order_count) AS total_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - overall_avg_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM scored
WHERE share > overall_avg_share;

assumptions.assumption: Each matching execution row counts once toward its order type; multiple executions for one order therefore count separately. The average share is the unweighted average across distinct ordertune groups, including NULL as its own group.
